additional_info.subject: 0443068 - ID0443068-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2/T5 314309754001] Dispenser is not working CRM:00314000217
additional_info.body:
Good evening Alexander,
I am reaching out from the Expert Services team in regards of ticket
ID0443068.
Apologies for the delayed answer.
Today I had a look at the charger+dispenser, and these are the active error flags:
From what I can see, the main problem is that the outlets of the dispenser are not available, as the charger could not group correctly DC3 and DC4.
DC3 Errorcode:3
means
state monitor fast shutdown check error.
DC4 Errorcode:8
means
no converters ready for charging use in entire charger.
E52 at the end of the powerconverter error flags means
Fast Shutdown check failed.
The error flag "Dispenser_PLC_A_KF201 -
PLC not in operating state run
, state 1" is just a consequence of the above points, it means that the dispenser outlets are not ready for operation however modbus communication with charger PLC is ok.
As a matter of fact, I connected via SSH to the charger, and I have communication to all 4 EcoGs and to the PLC of the dispenser.
To solve the problem, it is necessary to go onsite and perform some troubleshooting activities. I suspect the issue could be in the state monitor inside the dispenser KF214, so I would suggest to bring a spare one. If you can, please bring onsite a KF13 state monitor of the charger.
Was the dispenser just commissioned? Because then the problem could be in the connections between dispenser and charger.
Please let me know if you need support for the onsite activity. In case support is required, please let's align in advance and let's schedule the activity as per availability.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
Smart Infrastructure
